background: Managers download the weekly orders report as CSV to open it in a spreadsheet.

functional.text: A Download CSV button next to the weekly report table downloads the report as a CSV file.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Clicking Download CSV downloads a file named weekly-report-YYYY-MM-DD.csv (the day of the download).
The file has a header row with the table's column titles (Week, Orders, Revenue) and one row per week, comma separated, text fields quoted.

source.quote: use a comma as the separator and quote text fields

acceptanceCriteria.text: Revenue is written with two decimals.

source.quote: Revenue is shown with two decimals.

discussionOutcomes.text: The separator is a comma and text fields are quoted.

openQuestions.text: The description asks for the last 12 weeks; a comment asks for 26 weeks.
